If a coordinator fails, replicas elect a leader. Reads may still be stale after the election.

The payment handler is only idempotent if a request uses the original idempotency key. A client timeout does not confirm whether the first charge went through. Retrying with a new key loses this guarantee and can cause a second charge.

Backpressure slows incoming requests while the pending queue clears; it does not cancel requests that were already accepted.
